concept: Starting something yourself, instead of waiting for someone else to start it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character starts a small project or activity themselves instead of waiting to be told or invited
exercise.reflection_prompt: What might not have happened if the character had waited?
exercise.practice: Student names one small thing they could start themselves this week

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic thing they could initiate
